Shell over speed: 75 HP (1.36 x the Wolf), speed 0.5, short 2.0 aggro so the strand stays walkable. Borrows RatBite (quick nips) until it gets its own pincer skill. entityType SandClamper: placeholder art (one raised crusher), replaced at the Zone 1 art pass. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
